Sandbox_RSL_BalancedResidential_tooltip: Restricts the spawn pool to a hand picked set of residential spawn points spread evenly across each town. Recommended for most Multiplayer servers. Disabling towns in 'Random Spawn - Locations' will remove them from the pool. Unselect to fully customise your experience.
Sandbox_RSL_BalancedNonResidential_toolt: Restricts the spawn pool to a hand picked set of non-residential spawn points spread evenly across each town, including businesses, civic buildings and industrial locations. Can be combined with Balanced (Residential). Disabling towns in 'Random Spawn - Locations' will remove them from the pool.
Sandbox_RSL_Dixie_tooltip: Allow spawns in Dixie Trailer Park.
Sandbox_RSL_DoeValleyForest_tooltip: Allow spawns in Doe Valley Forest.
Sandbox_RSL_AnruisiTown_tooltip: Allow spawns in Anruisi Town. Requires the 'AnruisiTown (Military Bastion)' Map Mod. Modded Maps are never enabled by default.
Sandbox_RSL_Maplewood_tooltip: Allow spawns in Maplewood. Requires the 'Maplewood [B42]' Map Mod. Modded Maps are never enabled by default.
Sandbox_RSL_RavenCreek_tooltip: Allow spawns in Raven Creek. Requires the 'Raven Creek B42' Map Mod. Modded Maps are never enabled by default.
Sandbox_RSL_Residential_tooltip: Allow spawning in residential locations such as houses, apartments and trailers.
Sandbox_RSL_NonResidential_tooltip: Allow spawning in non-residential locations such as businesses, warehouses, civic buildings and offices.
Sandbox_RSL_HardcoreSpawns_tooltip: Allow spawning in dangerous or challenging locations such as police stations, jails and military zones. Not recommended for new players.
Sandbox_RSL_IsolatedAreas_tooltip: Allow spawning in remote and isolated locations such as forest cabins, scout camps and rural hideaways. These are far from towns and may have limited resources nearby.
Sandbox_RSL_Wilderness_tooltip: Allow spawning in open wilderness areas with no nearby buildings. Players will need to forage and survive with whatever they find. Extreme challenge — not recommended for new players.
Sandbox_RSL_BalancedWilderness_tooltip: Restricts Wilderness spawns to a smaller, hand picked set of Wilderness spawn points. Selecting 'Wilderness' as well (or on its own) always includes the full Wilderness pool regardless of this option. Unselect 'Wilderness' and keep only this on to spawn exclusively from the curated set.
